Migrant Boat Capsizes Off Djibouti, 109 Dead

A boat carrying migrants from Djibouti to Yemen capsized, resulting in the deaths of at least 109 people, including 15 children. More than 100 others are reported missing. A UN agency confirmed the death toll.
